residual_risks_for_review: R1 Unexecuted source: correctness rests on reading only; no positive or negative control has run.

R2 Sticky labels fail X6 for any post-baseline non-owned process, including child descendants first retained as unproved; intended by package-v9 4.5 and the receipt ownership_residual, but it makes non-quiet hosts unusable for beta audits.
R3 Receipt-to-ACK exact prefix joins assume append-only, never-mutated supervisor history entries (verified by reading L1211-1219 and L1135-1145); any producer change fails closed (HELD).
R4 Nonempty raw_acquisitions, timing_failed or history_overflow is HELD; if a healthy supervisor19 run can leave a completed raw acquisition pending, the bridge HOLDs (availability, not safety).
R5 date_now refuses after any failure, so some UNSETTLED runs HOLD DATE_UNAVAILABLE instead of yielding READY with X6 failure (fail closed).
R6 Freeze coverage is stricter than adapter3 (includes bridge-only evidence: request, wait doc, union, supervisor captures, launch record, configs, GO files).

R7 Union role labels other than driver/main_child/identity-less helper are not cross-checked against receipt classification; sticky labels make this non-blocking for safety but CP2 should classify roles exactly.
